subject: StratusOne CAIQ crosswalk and evidence sampling plan
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@stratusone.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, procure@stratusone.com
Cc: CloudWorks Security <security@cloudworks.io>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ crosswalk request and sampling window

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team at StratusOne is preparing for a CSA assessment and has asked for a CAIQ crosswalk mapping from Redwood to confirm control coverage and to collect representative evidence for a few high-priority control families (runtime isolation, key management, telemetry/telemetry retention).

Specifically they asked for: 
- A control crosswalk (CAIQ control ID -> Redwood control name/owner)
- One representative artifact per asserted control (logs, runbooks, key rotation proof, attestation statements)
- A short sampling window (30 days preferred) and note on where redaction or tenant-scoped exports occur

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide an initial package by the week of July 30? Also include who the control owners will be for the sampled artifacts. If there are limitations for any controls (e.g., redactions, multi-tenant masking), please call them out.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Sr. Security Program Manager
StratusOne

Attachments: none
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@stratusone.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, CloudWorks Security <security@cloudworks.io>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ crosswalk request and sampling window

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can assemble an initial CAIQ crosswalk and a targeted evidence sampling bundle for the runtime isolation and key management families by July 30. What we plan to deliver:

- CAIQ crosswalk workbook (tabbed by control family) with Redwood control references and named owners.
- Evidence sampling matrix: one exemplar artifact per claimed control (log extracts, rotation records, architecture diagram excerpts, attestation snippets).
- Notes on redaction and tenant-scoped exports plus a one-page runbook for extracting the 30-day telemetry window.

I’ve attached a draft crosswalk workbook and the sampling matrix as starters (see attached). Marissa and Jonas are looped in to pull the telemetry extracts and key management artifacts. 

Quick question: for sampling, do you prefer a 30-day continuous window or three 10-day windows to show variability? We can do either but want to be efficient with the artifact pulls.

Action items we’ll take now:
- Marissa: prepare telemetry extract recipe and estimate (logs, request traces, retention proof).
- Jonas: export key rotation and KMS attestation bits; confirm HSM/KMS split for private deployments.
- Kimberly: finalize crosswalk and executive cover note.

If that works I’ll target an upload to a shared Drive folder and send a DocuSign link for the SOW addendum (if procurement still needs it).

Thanks — speak soon.

Kimberly Park
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: caiq-crosswalk-stratusone.xlsx; evidence-sampling-matrix.csv
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Jul 2028 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Evidence pull details for StratusOne CAIQ sample

Marissa / Jonas —

Following up on Elena's ask. Please see the itemized artifact list below and the requested delivery timeline (target for central upload: 07/29 end-of-day PST). Note that the customer wants a single exemplar per asserted control; we should avoid full system exports unless they explicitly request deeper sampling.

Requested artifacts (high priority):
- Runtime isolation: 30-day request trace extract (include tenant id hash, timestamps). File: log-retention-sample.txt
- KV/cache eviction/segregation note: small runbook snippet showing tenant-scoped KV policy (redact tenant IDs in the example).
- Key management: key rotation ledger + KMS access log excerpt for the 30-day window (confirm HSM-backed entries vs software keys).
- Telemetry retention: storage lifecycle proof and a retention policy excerpt from the policy repo.
- Control owner attestation: short 1-paragraph owner statement for each claimed control (name + title).

Constraints / notes:
- Redaction: for runtime traces we must hash tenant IDs and remove PII by default. Keep a mapping note for auditors explaining the hash approach.
- Export process: telemetry extracts are generated from the observability pipeline; Marissa, estimate the compute/time and whether you need a maintenance window.
- Packaging: put artifacts in the shared Drive path with GUIDed filenames and a short manifest.

Can you confirm feasibility by EOD Monday and flag any items that will take longer? I’ll stitch the crosswalk to the artifacts and write the cover note for the auditor.

Thanks,
Kimberly

> 
> Appreciate the clear ask. We can assemble an initial CAIQ crosswalk…

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@stratusone.com>, CloudWorks Security <security@cloudworks.io>, procure@stratusone.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: CAIQ crosswalk + exemplar evidence bundle (StratusOne)

Hi Elena and team —

Thanks for the patience. We’ve uploaded the initial CAIQ crosswalk and a curated exemplar evidence bundle to the shared Drive folder linked below. The package contains the crosswalk workbook, the sampling matrix, and the exemplar artifacts requested for runtime isolation, key management, and telemetry retention. 

What’s included (high level):
- caiq-crosswalk-stratusone.xlsx: mapping of CAIQ controls to Redwood controls, named owners, and short assertion text.
- evidence-sampling-matrix.csv: list of artifacts, sampling window (2028-06-30 to 2028-07-29), and file locations.
- log-retention-sample.txt: redacted telemetry extract (tenant hashes, timestamps) — see manifest for hash method.
- KMS-rotation-2028.pdf: rotation ledger and attestations (HSM-backed keys indicated).
- access-instructions.pdf: instructions for reviewer access to the Drive package and read-only viewer accounts.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFghIJkLmnopQRS
DocuSign (SOW addendum): https://www.docusign.com/sign/EXAMPLE-STRAT-SOW
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Notes and caveats:
- We produced a 30-day continuous sampling window as requested. If your assessment team prefers split windows to show variability, let us know and we can regenerate smaller extracts.
- Redaction approach: tenant identifiers are hashed using a reversible key held in our evidence vault; auditors can request temporary mapping under an NDA if needed.
- Control gaps: there are two non-asserted subcontrols in the CAIQ key management family that require integration-level proofs for on-prem HSM deployments; we’ve flagged these in the crosswalk and suggested compensating controls.

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and whether the package is sufficient for your CSA assessor.
- If procurement requires the SOW addendum signature, the DocuSign link is above.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: caiq-crosswalk-stratusone.xlsx; evidence-sampling-matrix.csv; log-retention-sample.txt; KMS-rotation-2028.pdf
